maria: quick brain dump — thinking of a small "Token Sleuth" panel in Console that shows token-level cost spikes + attributed cache-savings by model/route. want to iterate on data contract before i mock UI. cc @aj @devon :eyes:
aj: love the name. quick q — how do we attribute shared prefetch/cache savings back to route/tenant? that's the tricky bit.
devon: we log prefetch events with fingerprint + route_id. attribution is basically join by fingerprint, but when prefetch is shared across routes we need a heuristics layer (first-touch, proportional by recent traffic, or sampled lineage). sampling affects confidence.
sam: UI note — keep the card compact: sparkline + 24h delta + net-cost. then a "why" flyout with sampled example queries and joins to evals. Avoid huge tables by default. :rocket:
lee: +1 on net-cost. Also surface "amortized model unit cost" (e.g., model_sku unit cost after reserved pools/quantization) because users will misread raw token numbers.
maria: rough proto SQL i'm going to try as a materialized view for the panel (feedback welcome):
```
SELECT route_id, model_sku,
  SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens,
  SUM(tokens)*cost_per_token AS nominal_cost,
  SUM(prefetch_saved_tokens) AS saved_tokens,
  SUM(prefetch_saved_tokens)*cost_per_token AS saved_cost,
  (SUM(tokens)*cost_per_token - SUM(prefetch_saved_tokens)*cost_per_token) AS net_cost
FROM token_events_sampled
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY route_id, model_sku
ORDER BY net_cost DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
aj: looks ok but a few caveats: cost_per_token is model-version + quant-level dependent. join to model_catalog (model_version, quant_profile) to compute accurate cost vectors.
devon: also recommend adding hit_certainty and kv_ttl fields. saved_tokens should be weighted: exact hit=1, probabilistic match=0.5, stale match=0.1. otherwise we over-credit prefetch.
sam: rollout UX idea — show canary vs baseline rows side-by-side so PMs/Eng can see if a new model or config drove the delta. toggle compare-with-previous-version.
lee: quota semantics: net_cost might go negative (prefetch credits >bare cost). still want quotas to enforce token-limits separately from billing credits. need to be explicit in the panel: "billing vs quota".
maria: good catch. ops question on sampling: 1% vs 5%? devon suggested adaptive sampling per-route to reduce noise. thoughts on thresholds?
devon: adaptive sampling: start 1% globally, ramp to 5-10% for routes with >5% net-cost variance in last 6h OR >1k tokens/s. keep deterministic hashing so attributions are stable across windows.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: feature branch 'token-sleuth' CI green, queued for staging deploy (canary window: 30m).
aj: action items: @sam mocks the compact and expanded card; @devon provides telemetry contract (fields + hit_confidence + sample_scaling); @maria drafts MV + SQL PR and materialization schedule. propose 2-week alpha to staging canary.
maria: sounds good — i'll stub the panel and wire the sparkline API to the MV. thanks all :thumbsup:
sam: i'll take the mockups, compact card + expanded table. prefer a small "explain" tooltip on net-cost calc to avoid support noise.
